title: LISA Drops New Limited-Edition Merch for Her PlayStation Collab: Shop the BLACKPINK Star’s Designs Online
summary: The partnership features the PS5 wireless controller, a merch line available now exclusively through LISA's official Amazon store and a second merch line available for preorder through PlayStation.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Looks like LISA has her eyes on your next outfit, with the BLACKPINK star’s new PlayStation merch featuring her distinctive gaze.

Designed in collaboration with LISA, the first merchandise drop accompanying her PlayStation collaboration is now available exclusively through her official Amazon store . The collection expands on the partnership behind the limited-edition LISA × PlayStation DualSense wireless controller , bringing her own style to PlayStation-inspired apparel and accessories.

shop amazon-exclusive lisa x playstation full line here

Fans can also preorder a second merch drop directly through the PlayStation Store ahead of its expected release later this month — with PlayStation yet to confirm an official release date. The upcoming drop features a black “LISA” beanie, a tote bag and graphic T-shirts with a fresh spin on the original designs. The PS5 controller, which opened for preorder on Oct. 2, is scheduled to release on Oct. 30. All merchandise are available exclusively in the U.S.

Available for preorder now ahead of its Oct. 30 release date, this wireless controller is compatible with PS5, PC, Mac and mobile.

shop lisa x playstation full line here

The full LISA x PlayStation collection features t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, hats, tote bags, keychains/bag charms, stickers and a DualSense controller carrying case. Product availability may vary by retailer, with the first drop available now on Amazon and a second lineup available to preorder through PlayStation .

The collaboration builds on PlayStation’s first PS5 campaign with LISA last year and arrives alongside her EP “Press Play,” released on Oct. 23 . In a press release, LISA shared her excitement about creating the collection and adding personal details for fans to appreciate.

“Gaming is something I do whenever I have time to relax, so getting to create this collection with PlayStation was very exciting,” the K-pop star said. “I had a lot of fun adding in little details that I knew my fans would notice, and I wanted the fans to have something they can connect with. I’ve always loved expressing myself through music and fashion, so this collaboration gave me a new way to be creative and show a different side of myself. I hope everyone enjoys it as much as I do.”
